decisive_items: Initial serum β-hCG: 691 IU/L (normal 0-5 IU/L), increased to 1860 IU/L on repeat
Immunostaining positive for AE1/AE3, CAM5.2, inhibin, β-hCG (strongly)
Poorly differentiated tumor composed of syncytial, intermediate in situ trophoblastic cells
response.rationale: Elevated β-hCG with strong IHC positivity and trophoblastic histology are diagnostic of choriocarcinoma; R3 is a broader category, while R2 and R4 lack specific tumor markers and histology.

rejected.why: Describes hemorrhagic adrenal mass but ignores β-hCG and trophoblastic pathology; hemorrhage is secondary.
Pulmonary nodules and family history are nonspecific; no evidence of a primary non-germ-cell malignancy.
